2608.02302.title: Trajectories That Segment Themselves: Agent-Declared Boundaries as a Training Unit
2608.02302.paper_summary: Long-horizon coding-agent trajectories are poorly matched to the credit units available to train on: a single action has no stable value, an episode label merges productive exploration with abandoned directions, and a fixed window cuts where the logging mechanics fall. We introduce collection-time semantic self-segmentation, in which a declarative contract has the acting agent expose its own boundaries while the trajectory is generated. Instantiated with falsifiable causal hypotheses, successive adoptions expose variable-length semantic phases, and no milestone vocabulary, gold patch, environment replay, teacher logits, or retrospective segmenter places a boundary. Because the agent names its conjecture, a reviewer can negate it by name, which lets our protocol manufacture wrong-cause-then-correction transitions that recorded work rarely contains; one collection then yields four supervised targets, including audit supervision from exactly the failed regions an episode label discards. We then ask what survives deleting the declaration. Given the cut points but not the hypothesis, a model attributes action blocks to their governing hypothesis at over twice chance, beating equal-length blocks over the same trajectories (paired sign test $p = 0.0002$), surviving a lexical control and collapsing under label permutation. Asked instead to place boundaries, a code-blind annotator matches 24 of 40 where random placement matches 11.5, while a mechanical test-event rule beats chance at neither end of a strict-to-permissive sweep. The segments are therefore coherent and not cheaply reproducible. Downstream, DPO on 2,551 phase-boundary pairs changes no decision on 91 adversarial held-out items, while four of 60 change on matched-construction items, all wrong to right, where two controls change none: with 1,825 pairs from one generator, the variable to vary next is corpus diversity, not the boundary.
2608.02302.paper_summary_zh: 長期的編碼代理軌跡與可用於訓練的信用單位不匹配：單一行動沒有穩定的價值，情節標籤將有成效的探索與被放棄的方向合併，而固定窗口則切斷了記錄機制的落點。我們引入了收集時間語義自我分割，其中一個宣告性契約使得行動代理在生成軌跡時暴露其自身邊界。通過可證偽的因果假設實例化，連續的採用暴露出可變長度的語義階段，並且沒有里程碑詞彙、金色補丁、環境重播、教師邏輯或回顧性分割器設置邊界。因為代理命名其推測，審查者可以通過名稱否定它，這使我們的協議能夠製造錯因然後修正的轉變，而記錄的工作很少包含這種轉變；一次收集則產生四個監督目標，包括來自情節標籤丟棄的確切失敗區域的審計監督。我們接著詢問刪除宣告後存活下來的內容。在給定切點但不給假設的情況下，模型將行動區塊歸因於其主導假設的概率超過兩倍，擊敗相同軌跡上等長區塊的機會（配對符號檢驗 $p = 0.0002$），在詞彙控制下存活並在標籤置換下崩潰。相反地，被要求設置邊界的無代碼註釋者在40個中匹配了24個，而隨機放置僅匹配11.5，機械測試事件規則在嚴格到寬鬆的範圍內兩端都未能擊敗機會。因此，這些片段是連貫的，並且不容易重現。在下游，對2,551個階段邊界對的DPO在91個對抗性保留項目上不改變任何決策，而在匹配建構項目中60個中有四個改變，全部從錯誤變為正確，其中兩個控制沒有改變：從一個生成器獲得1,825對的情況下，下次要變化的變數是語料庫多樣性，而不是邊界。
2608.02302.author: Jingxi Wei et.al.
